content.short: Infinitism Bundler is a reference ERC-4337 bundler for Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, BNB Chain, Avalanche, and Multichain.
content.description: Infinitism Bundler is the reference ERC-4337 bundler built by the original authors of EIP-4337, including Dror Tirosh and Shahaf Nacson. The TypeScript implementation includes an SDK to send and receive UserOperation, enabling seamless integration of account abstraction in dApps. It supports Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, BNB Chain, Avalanche, and Multichain, providing a versatile tooling layer for bundling user operations across multiple networks.

resources.title: What a Bundler Is Responsible For
resources.tldr: It collects UserOperations, simulates each for validity, and packs them into one call to the EntryPoint. The reference docs.

resources.title: The Rules a Bundler Enforces
resources.tldr: Validation cannot touch arbitrary storage or deploy contracts, because the bundler has to trust its own simulation. Why those limits exist.
